pairs.en: “If the boats do not sail, this year's grain must be sold and the proceeds remitted,” Chunshou said. “The Board of Revenue fixes the rate at two taels per shi. What is the current market price?”

pairs.source_zh: “这要看米的成色。”被推定去回话的那个尖丁答道：
pairs.source_en: “That depends on the quality,” answered the headman chosen to speak for them.
pairs.zh: “这要看米的成色。”被推定去回话的那个尖丁答道：
pairs.en: “That depends on the quality,” answered the headman chosen to speak for them.

pairs.source_zh: “总在七钱到八钱这个数目之间。”
pairs.source_en: “Somewhere between seven and eight tenths of a tael.”
pairs.zh: “总在七钱到八钱这个数目之间。”
pairs.en: “Somewhere between seven and eight tenths of a tael.”

pairs.source_zh: “船上的漕粮有多少？”
pairs.source_en: “How much grain is on the boats?”
pairs.zh: “船上的漕粮有多少？”
pairs.en: “How much grain is on the boats?”

pairs.source_zh: “一共二十七万六千石。”
pairs.source_en: “A total of 276,000 shi.”
pairs.zh: “一共二十七万六千石。”
pairs.en: “A total of 276,000 shi.”

pairs.source_zh: “那么，”椿寿问道，“就算每石赔一两二钱银子，共该多少？”
pairs.source_en: “Then,” Chunshou asked, “if we lose one tael and two tenths on every shi, what does that come to?”
pairs.zh: “那么，”椿寿问道，“就算每石赔一两二钱银子，共该多少？”
pairs.en: “Then,” Chunshou asked, “if we lose one tael and two tenths on every shi, what does that come to?”

pairs.source_zh: 那尖丁的心算极快，
pairs.source_en: The headman was quick at mental arithmetic.
pairs.zh: 那尖丁的心算极快，
pairs.en: The headman was quick at mental arithmetic.

pairs.source_zh: 略略迟疑了一下，便报出确数：
pairs.source_en: After scarcely a pause, he supplied the exact figure.
pairs.zh: 略略迟疑了一下，便报出确数：
pairs.en: After scarcely a pause, he supplied the exact figure.

pairs.source_zh: “共该三十三万一千二百两银子。”
pairs.zh: “共该三十三万一千二百两银子。”

pairs.source_zh: “如果漕船不走，奏请变价缴银，上头一定会准的。
pairs.source_en: “If the boats cannot sail, the throne will certainly approve a request to sell the grain and remit silver instead.
pairs.zh: “如果漕船不走，奏请变价缴银，上头一定会准的。
pairs.en: “If the boats cannot sail, the throne will certainly approve a request to sell the grain and remit silver instead.

pairs.source_zh: 不过，”椿寿面色凝重地问，“这三十三万两银子，该谁来赔？”
pairs.source_en: But”—Chunshou's face grew grave—“who is to make up those three hundred and thirty-odd thousand taels?”
pairs.zh: 不过，”椿寿面色凝重地问，“这三十三万两银子，该谁来赔？”
pairs.en: But”—Chunshou's face grew grave—“who is to make up those three hundred and thirty-odd thousand taels?”

pairs.source_zh: “大人晓得的，湖属八帮是‘疲帮’，
pairs.source_en: “Your Excellency knows that the eight Huzhou associations are financially exhausted.
pairs.zh: “大人晓得的，湖属八帮是‘疲帮’，
pairs.en: “Your Excellency knows that the eight Huzhou associations are financially exhausted.

pairs.source_zh: 力量实在够不上。
pairs.source_en: We simply haven't the means.
pairs.zh: 力量实在够不上。
pairs.en: We simply haven't the means.

pairs.source_zh: 总要请大人格外体恤，留漕丁一条命。”
pairs.source_en: We must beg you to show special consideration and leave the boatmen a chance to survive.”
pairs.zh: 总要请大人格外体恤，留漕丁一条命。”
pairs.en: We must beg you to show special consideration and leave the boatmen a chance to survive.”

pairs.source_zh: “哼！”椿寿冷笑，
pairs.source_en: “Hmph!” Chunshou gave a cold laugh.
pairs.zh: “哼！”椿寿冷笑，
pairs.en: “Hmph!” Chunshou gave a cold laugh.

pairs.source_zh: “你们要命，
pairs.source_en: “You want to save your lives.
pairs.zh: “你们要命，
pairs.en: “You want to save your lives.

pairs.source_zh: 难道我的命就可以不要？”
pairs.source_en: Is mine the only one that does not matter?”
pairs.zh: 难道我的命就可以不要？”
pairs.en: Is mine the only one that does not matter?”

pairs.source_zh: 这是双方讨价还价，有意做作。
pairs.source_en: Both sides were bargaining, putting on a show.
pairs.zh: 这是双方讨价还价，有意做作。
pairs.en: Both sides were bargaining, putting on a show.

pairs.source_zh: 漕帮有“屯田”，有“公费”，
pairs.source_en: The transport associations possessed agricultural estates and collective funds.
pairs.zh: 漕帮有“屯田”，有“公费”，
pairs.en: The transport associations possessed agricultural estates and collective funds.

pairs.source_zh: 遇到这种情形，便得从公众的产业和收入中，提出款子来赔，
pairs.source_en: In circumstances like these, they had to draw on their common property and income to cover losses.
pairs.zh: 遇到这种情形，便得从公众的产业和收入中，提出款子来赔，
pairs.en: In circumstances like these, they had to draw on their common property and income to cover losses.

pairs.source_zh: 赔累的成数，并无定章，
pairs.source_en: There was no fixed rule governing their share.
pairs.zh: 赔累的成数，并无定章，
pairs.en: There was no fixed rule governing their share.

pairs.source_zh: 但以上压下，首先要看帮的好坏，
pairs.source_en: Pressure came from above, and the first consideration was an association's financial condition.
pairs.zh: 但以上压下，首先要看帮的好坏，
pairs.en: Pressure came from above, and the first consideration was an association's financial condition.

pairs.source_zh: 公产多的“旺帮”便赔得多，负债累累的“疲帮”便赔得少。
pairs.source_en: Prosperous associations with substantial communal assets paid more; exhausted associations burdened with debt paid less.
pairs.zh: 公产多的“旺帮”便赔得多，负债累累的“疲帮”便赔得少。
pairs.en: Prosperous associations with substantial communal assets paid more; exhausted associations burdened with debt paid less.

pairs.source_zh: 说也奇怪，越是富庶的地区，漕帮越疲，
pairs.source_en: Curiously enough, the richer the district, the poorer its transport associations tended to be.
pairs.zh: 说也奇怪，越是富庶的地区，漕帮越疲，
pairs.en: Curiously enough, the richer the district, the poorer its transport associations tended to be.

pairs.source_zh: 第一疲帮是江苏松江府属各帮，溯州府属八帮的境况也不见得好，
pairs.source_en: Those under Songjiang in Jiangsu were the most impoverished, and the eight Huzhou associations were not much better off.
pairs.zh: 第一疲帮是江苏松江府属各帮，溯州府属八帮的境况也不见得好，
pairs.en: Those under Songjiang in Jiangsu were the most impoverished, and the eight Huzhou associations were not much better off.

pairs.source_zh: 这因为是越富庶的地区，剥削越多的缘故。
pairs.source_en: The explanation was that richer districts suffered heavier exactions.
pairs.zh: 这因为是越富庶的地区，剥削越多的缘故。
pairs.en: The explanation was that richer districts suffered heavier exactions.

pairs.source_zh: 这赔累的差额，除了漕帮以外，主要的使得由藩司从征收漕粮的各种陋规和“浮收”中，提成分赔。
pairs.source_en: Beyond the associations' contribution, most of the shortfall had to be met by the provincial treasurer out of a share of the unofficial fees and excess collections associated with the grain tax.
pairs.zh: 这赔累的差额，除了漕帮以外，主要的使得由藩司从征收漕粮的各种陋规和“浮收”中，提成分赔。
pairs.en: Beyond the associations' contribution, most of the shortfall had to be met by the provincial treasurer out of a share of the unofficial fees and excess collections associated with the grain tax.

pairs.source_zh: 所以处理这件棘手的案子，实际上只是藩台衙门和湖属八帮间的事。
pairs.source_en: In practice, therefore, this difficult affair concerned only the provincial treasury and Huzhou's eight associations.
pairs.zh: 所以处理这件棘手的案子，实际上只是藩台衙门和湖属八帮间的事。
pairs.en: In practice, therefore, this difficult affair concerned only the provincial treasury and Huzhou's eight associations.

pairs.source_zh: 椿寿软哄硬逼，总算把分赔的成数谈好了。
pairs.source_en: By alternately coaxing and pressuring them, Chunshou finally secured agreement on how the loss would be divided.
pairs.zh: 椿寿软哄硬逼，总算把分赔的成数谈好了。
pairs.en: By alternately coaxing and pressuring them, Chunshou finally secured agreement on how the loss would be divided.

pairs.source_zh: 然而这也不过是万不得已的退路。
pairs.source_en: That, however, was merely a last resort.
pairs.zh: 然而这也不过是万不得已的退路。
pairs.en: That, however, was merely a last resort.

pairs.source_zh: 眼光总是朝前看的，
pairs.source_en: It was still better to look for a way forward.
pairs.zh: 眼光总是朝前看的，
pairs.en: It was still better to look for a way forward.

pairs.source_zh: 能够把漕船开出去，交了差，也免了赔累，
pairs.source_en: If the boats could sail, the obligation would be fulfilled and the loss avoided.
pairs.zh: 能够把漕船开出去，交了差，也免了赔累，
pairs.en: If the boats could sail, the obligation would be fulfilled and the loss avoided.

pairs.source_zh: 何乐不为？
pairs.source_en: Why not try?
pairs.zh: 何乐不为？
pairs.en: Why not try?

pairs.source_zh: 所以椿寿又回过头来问：“照你们看，漕船到底能不能动呢？
pairs.source_en: Chunshou therefore returned to the original question. “In your judgement, can the boats move at all?
pairs.zh: 所以椿寿又回过头来问：“照你们看，漕船到底能不能动呢？
pairs.en: Chunshou therefore returned to the original question. “In your judgement, can the boats move at all?

pairs.source_zh: 能动还是照开的好。”
pairs.source_en: If they can, it would still be better to send them.”
pairs.zh: 能动还是照开的好。”
